title: Detailed red apple
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Shadow/underside glow -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='78' rx='30' ry='8' fill='#5C0A0A' opacity='0.5'/>
  
  <!-- Main apple body - base red -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='58' rx='32' ry='30' fill='#D42B2B'/>
  
  <!-- Left highlight lobe -->
  <ellipse cx='38' cy='50' rx='18' ry='22' fill='#E84040'/>
  
  <!-- Right highlight lobe -->
  <ellipse cx='62' cy='50' rx='18' ry='22' fill='#E84040'/>
  
  <!-- Bright specular highlight - left -->
  <ellipse cx='36' cy='42' rx='10' ry='14' fill='#F57070' transform='rotate(-15 36 42)'/>
  
  <!-- Brightest spot -->
  <ellipse cx='34' cy='38' rx='5' ry='7' fill='#FFA0A0' transform='rotate(-20 34 38)'/>
  
  <!-- Small secondary highlight right -->
  <ellipse cx='65' cy='48' rx='4' ry='6' fill='#F57070' transform='rotate(15 65 48)'/>
  
  <!-- Deep red shadow bottom -->
  <path d='M22 65 Q30 85 50 86 Q70 85 78 65 Q72 80 50 81 Q28 80 22 65Z' fill='#9B1A1A' opacity='0.7'/>
  
  <!-- Crease/indent at top where stem sits -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='34' rx='14' ry='5' fill='#B01E1E'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='34' rx='10' ry='3' fill='#8A1515'/>
  
  <!-- Stem -->
  <path d='M50 36 Q49 28 52 22 Q54 18 55 16' stroke='#6B3A1F' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round' fill='none'/>
  <path d='M50 36 Q49 28 52 22' stroke='#8B5A2F' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linecap='round' fill='none'/>
  
  <!-- Leaf -->
  <path d='M52 22 Q60 16 68 18 Q64 24 58 26 Q54 26 52 22Z' fill='#3DB83D'/>
  <path d='M54 22 Q60 19 66 19' stroke='#2D8A2D' stroke-width='1' fill='none'/>
  <path d='M55 23 Q58 20 62 20' stroke='#5CD85C' stroke-width='0.8' fill='none'/>
  
  <!-- Subtle skin texture dots -->
  <circle cx='42' cy='62' r='0.8' fill='#B81E1E' opacity='0.6'/>
  <circle cx='55' cy='66' r='0.8' fill='#B81E1E' opacity='0.6'/>
  <circle cx='48' cy='72' r='0.8' fill='#B81E1E' opacity='0.6'/>
  <circle cx='60' cy='58' r='0.7' fill='#B81E1E' opacity='0.5'/>
  <circle cx='38' cy='68' r='0.7' fill='#B81E1E' opacity='0.5'/>
  <circle cx='66' cy='64' r='0.6' fill='#B81E1E' opacity='0.5'/>
</svg>
